context: The fallback creates or mutates state, so the skill must preserve laziness and reject eager or null-based rewrites.

checklist.name: Uses map for present value
checklist.description: Uses Optional.map or an equivalent direct Optional boundary for the present Comment branch.

checklist.name: Fallback stays lazy
checklist.description: Uses orElseGet or an explicit lazy absent branch for create(text). Does not use orElse(create(text)).

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not introduce orElse(null), null checks, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Behavior preserved
checklist.description: Preserves updated/created behavior and passes text through to update/create.
